headline: Adani Power Q2 Net Profit Soars 141% on Surging Demand and Tariffs
summary: Adani Power reported a 141.5% increase in second-quarter net profit to Rs 9,125.12 crore, driven by strong demand, higher tariffs, and a one-time income boost.
why: Strong earnings reports from major utility providers highlight robust energy demand and pricing power within the power generation sector.

impacts.name: Adani Power
impacts.why: A significant profit jump driven by higher tariffs and strong demand directly improves corporate earnings.

why_moved: A triple-digit surge in net profit fueled by rising demand and favorable tariffs exceeds earnings expectations, boosting investor sentiment toward the utility.
